title: npm install of a pure-JS dependency, then require it
intent: Isolates dependency resolution from the toolchain: one small pure-JS package, installed and required. This is where a loader without exports-map support first shows its limits.
source: stackblitz-conformance: Package managers (npm) (public 'Runtime Test Cases for AI Agents' suite, adapted into our own scenario)

steps.purpose: Fetch and unpack one pure-JS package

knownLimits: A registry failure is NETWORK, never RUNTIME_INCOMPATIBILITY. Conflating the two would blame the runtime for the weather.
